test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) H ^ 5 T & M 4 @ 5 # 1 4 J 3 P H 9 L ! 5 2 (Right)

If all numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be fifth from the right?
solution:
**Given:**

(Left) H ^ 5 T & M 4 @ 5 # 1 4 J 3 P H 9 L ! 5 2 (Right)

**Concept:**

Drop all the numbers.

**Explanation:**

After dropping the numbers we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/912ceab616a3ac3af07cbbbc189d67b4f438b3b30616e3f234368f020c73dfc1.png] 

Fifth from the right is **J.**

Thus the correct answer is **'Option 2'.**
